question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Justifiable
solution:
The correct answer is '**Reasonable**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate **synonym** for the word "**Justifiable**" is: **Reasonable**.
 
• Meanings of the words:
 
 
• **Indefensible** (अरक्षणीय) - Not justifiable or capable of being defended.
 
• **Neutral** (तटस्थ) - Not favoring either side in a dispute; impartial.
 
• **Maintainable** (रखने योग्य) - Capable of being maintained or defended.
 
• **Reasonable** (उचित) - Fair and sensible; based on good sense or sound judgment. 
 
 
 
• *Example sentence: The decision to increase taxes seemed reasonable given the current economic situation.*
